            I am an Assistant Professor in the Department of
            Economics at Sciences Po, and I work on questions in
            environmental economics, empirical industrial organization
            and labor economics.
            Prior to joining Sciences Po, I was a Postdoctoral
            Researcher at the Columbia University Center for Political
            Economy in 2025-2026, and I received my PhD in Sustainable
            Development from Columbia University.
            I go by Emma and use she/her pronouns.
